source: LittlePEng — Wind Load Calculation as per ASCE 7-22
procedure: Single-surface MWFRS-style velocity pressure + design pressure
description: Brief overview-level calculation. Useful only as a qz / single-surface sanity check, NOT a full MWFRS reference.
limitations: Single-surface calc only — no leeward, side, roof, or internal-pressure cases shown.

Source places Kd inside qz (the 7-16 form), which CONTRADICTS the CED source's stated 7-22 Kd-moved-to-p change. So the LittlePEng formula structure itself is suspect for 7-22 — they may be using the older 7-16 convention while citing 7-22.
Article is introductory blog content, not authoritative.

expected_intermediates.qz_formula_per_source: qz = 0.00256 * Kz * Kzt * Kd * Ke * V^2  (Kd IS in qz per this source — disagrees with CED on edition treatment)

use_as_test: ONLY use to sanity-check the single-surface qz * G * Cp pipeline. Do NOT use as authoritative for Kd placement — sources disagree.
